title: Character Curio sheet template
description: A reusable sheet layout: { id (static), version, updatedAt, character: {...} } with Library listing metadata stored on character.view.listing. Trait sets carry stable ids joining character overrides to template layout. Imports dedupe by static id.

id.description: Static template identifier. Assigned once, never regenerated; imports replace the same id instead of duplicating.

character.description: Character-shaped blank carrying the layout (view at sheet and set level) plus blank traits.
